terminology.hostless_test: XCTest executes in ProvenanceTests on macOS without an application test host and without hv_vm entry.
terminology.app_hosted_test: A separately configured signed application process hosts the outer integration harness; this alone still does not prove guest entry.
terminology.guest_backed_test: An evidence-source label that must name the exact fixed predicate executed guest-side. The admitted signed application causes production hv_vm/hv_vcpu entry and joins exact native guest observations through teardown.
terminology.live_h3_seeded_host_h4_integration: A real H3 guest run is joined to host Swift or host SQLite H4 work. It is not guest-resident H4 and is not guest-backed H4 computation.
terminology.guest_resident_test: The tested workload itself executes inside the guest. General XCTest, SQLite and H4 Swift residency are unsupported by the current fixed bare-metal images; a future exact fixed H4 known-answer workload is feasible only after a new guest profile and ABI.
terminology.prime_git_vm_test: A test runner executes in the separate Prime Git VM. No such runner, source transfer, toolchain or evidence channel is presently frozen or connected to this workflow.
terminology.physical_verifier_qualification: An exact separately administered device, transport, live key ceremony and durable rollback-resistant store are exercised. No current host or guest test provides this evidence.

immediate_successor_sequence.action: Commit this one-path control-only workflow correction with the pure preflight implementation as its exact parent.

Run the bounded full hostless ProvenanceTests suite in Debug and Release on the exact current tree before any guest launch. Retain the already audited helper-process, SIGCONT and deliberate-child-SIGKILL counts separately from the guest lane.

Perform a static no-entry feasibility gate for exactly two candidate mechanisms: a separately configured app-hosted XCTest target or the established signed-application one-shot plus external canonical-report verifier. Select exactly one design for the next freeze. Prefer the signed-application one-shot unless static inspection shows app-hosted XCTest can preserve the production signing, entitlement, lifecycle and Release shape. This gate cannot prove effective runtime admission.
immediate_successor_sequence.retention_limit: No source or project edit may be retained by this gate; compile products remain disposable derived data. Any needed implementation change belongs to order 5.

immediate_successor_sequence.action: Freeze the selected signed H3 qualification runner, exact production lifecycle entry, closed one-run activation grammar, acyclic inner-report/outer-receipt/final-manifest evidence, signature and effective-entitlement predicates, fixed-minimal environment, outer-issued nonce binding, monotonic deadline, application cancellation, teardown, quarantine, and signed Debug/Release matrix. The freeze must name one exact-positive-PID SIGKILL containment action and exact reap, maximum once per launched app and used only after the hard deadline; containment can never prove teardown.

Implement only the frozen runner and pure evidence verifier. Test malformed, truncated, duplicate, stale, identity-mismatch, signing-mismatch, timeout, cancellation, quarantine, abnormal-exit and containment representations as synthetic parser rejection vectors; do not claim live lifecycle coverage from them.

Because runner, project or shared-source changes invalidate the earlier current-tree regression, rerun the bounded full hostless Debug and Release suite before joining any guest evidence to a checkpoint.

Execute one bounded signed Debug and one bounded signed Release admission-only application launch through the selected runner with Hypervisor entry disabled and hv_vm_create_count fixed at zero. Verify actual process identity, signature and effective entitlement metadata; runtime Hypervisor admission remains unproven until guest entry.
immediate_successor_sequence.boundedness: Each admission-only launch is subject to the same frozen monotonic deadline, exact-positive-PID containment maximum and exact reap as a guest launch. Containment makes the admission result incomplete.

immediate_successor_sequence.action: After exact binary, image, signing, effective-entitlement, lifecycle and effect review, execute one bounded signed Debug H3 guest qualification and one bounded signed Release H3 guest qualification. The outer observer uses the frozen hard deadline; on expiry it may send the single frozen SIGKILL to the exact positive app PID and must reap it. A contained run is incomplete failure evidence and cannot claim guest teardown.
immediate_successor_sequence.boundedness: The observer wait always ends at the frozen monotonic deadline. Normal application-owned return is required for PASS; deadline containment exists only to prevent an indefinite launched process.

test_reporting_rules: Every result must name runner_location, subject_location, app_launched, hv_vm_created, guest_entered, sqlite_opened, helper_processes, signals, signing_state and authority_effect.

Guest-backed evidence must name the exact guest-side predicate and prove at least one production hv_vcpu_run entry for the selected fixed image. Guest-backed PASS additionally requires complete host-owned per-phase teardown.

An H3 PASS requires exactly two ordered vCPU entries, source then target, with phase conservation and complete teardown before the next interval. A partial entry is guest-backed failure evidence only.
A hostless or app-hosted test with fabricated native values remains synthetic even when it links guest-related source.
A signed app build without launch is not live evidence; an app launch without guest entry is not guest evidence.
Host SQLite evidence and guest execution evidence are separate and must be joined explicitly; neither implies the other.
A nonzero exit, abnormal termination, external containment kill or missing reap cannot claim successful application-owned teardown. It may be retained only as bounded failure evidence.
Copied native observations are claims made relative to the exact pinned and instrumented application/native binary; they are not an independent host attestation.
Prime Git VM execution, if ever selected, must be labeled prime_git_vm and cannot be reported as embedded product guest execution.
Physical verifier authority cannot be inferred from the embedded guest, Prime Git VM, local Git, host SQLite or their combination.

qualification_evidence_artifacts.acyclic_binding: The signed application emits inner report bytes before exit. After EOF, bounded wait and exact reap, the outer controller emits a receipt containing the inner-report SHA-256. A final retained manifest contains the SHA-256 of both prior artifacts. The final checkpoint records the manifest SHA-256. No artifact contains its own hash and no earlier artifact contains a later artifact hash.

inner_application_h3_report.producer: exact signed product application after the production native H3 function returns and application-side semantic verification completes, but before process exit

outer_observer_receipt.producer: the selected external qualification controller after inner-report EOF and either normal exit plus exact reap or frozen deadline containment plus exact reap
outer_observer_receipt.identity_rule: The controller executable and signed application executable are two separately hashed and UUID-pinned identities for the preferred one-shot pattern; neither is called merely runner_sha256.

final_retained_manifest.producer: the outer controller after both prior artifacts and all allowlisted evidence files are closed
final_retained_manifest.self_hash_rule: The manifest contains no manifest hash. The final checkpoint computes and records the SHA-256 of the closed manifest bytes.

runner_freeze_semantics.environment: The outer controller constructs a frozen fixed-minimal environment and rejects or removes inherited extras. Only non-secret allowlisted names and literal public values are recorded; inherited values and their digests are never retained.
runner_freeze_semantics.nonce: Immediately before each spawn, the outer controller issues exactly 32 bytes from SecRandomCopyBytes, records the lowercase hexadecimal value in the outer receipt, supplies it through the frozen closed activation grammar, requires the inner application report to echo it exactly, and rejects reuse within the retained qualification checkpoint.
runner_freeze_semantics.clock: All enforcement uses mach_continuous_time with recorded mach_timebase_info numerator and denominator. Wall-clock timestamps may be descriptive only and never decide deadline or ordering.
runner_freeze_semantics.containment: After the frozen monotonic deadline only, the controller may send SIGKILL exactly once to the exact positive PID it spawned, never to a process group, and must perform an exact reap. Such containment proves bounded observation only and never proves application-owned guest teardown.

negative_evidence_classes.effect_rule: Synthetic rejection vectors do not qualify live lifecycle behavior. A deliberate live fault campaign requires a separate freeze with exact app and guest run counts, exact fault injection, exact-positive-PID signal maxima, exact reap behavior and explicit user effect authorization. Incidental failure or containment during a positive run is retained as incomplete evidence but does not qualify a negative campaign.

implementation_constraints.hostless_target: Remain hostless and retain its deterministic preflight role.
implementation_constraints.live_target: Use a static no-entry feasibility gate to select exactly one runner design: a separately configured app-hosted XCTest target or the established signed-application one-shot plus external canonical-report verifier. Prefer the signed-application one-shot unless static inspection shows app-hosted XCTest can preserve the production signing, entitlement, lifecycle and Release shape. Static inspection cannot prove effective runtime admission; that proof begins with the separate signed Debug and Release admission-only launches and completes for Hypervisor admission only through real guest entry. The selected runner must support bounded signed Debug and Release activation.
implementation_constraints.native_execution: All hv_vm and hv_vcpu operations remain in the production HypervisorGuest implementation on its dedicated worker thread.
implementation_constraints.guest_inputs: Remain fixed and bounded. No caller path, arbitrary image, shell, environment, command language or network input is added.
implementation_constraints.current_guest_capacity: The H3 image and mappings cannot carry the approximately one-megabyte H4 maximum aggregate request. Any future H4 guest profile needs a separately frozen bounded mailbox or scatter/gather ABI.
implementation_constraints.sqlite_location: Existing D3 SQLite code remains host-side because the embedded guest has no filesystem, VFS or block device.
implementation_constraints.release_coverage: A Debug-only development convenience is insufficient for final guest qualification; exact signed Debug and Release product images must be distinguished.
implementation_constraints.effect_authorization: A committed control freeze is a prerequisite, not execution authority. Host helper processes and signals, app launches, guest entries, deadline containment, SQLite integration, live entropy/key material/signing, transport and external hardware each require their separately stated exact effect authorization.
implementation_constraints.prime_git_vm: Do not inventory, launch, stop, mount, mutate, copy to or configure it in this sequence.

dirty_file_guard.ambient_evidence_rule: All unrelated untracked and ignored evidence remains unstaged, unmodified, unmoved and unpruned.
